newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound slipped in a liquid end-of-week market on Wednesday to a range of 9-7/8 to 10-1/8 percent against Tuesday's range of 10 to 10-1/4 percent, bankers said.
One-week was little dealt but two bankers quoted rates in the range 10 to 10-1/8 percent, down from between 10-1/16 and 10-3/8 percent on Tuesday.
"It's liquid, as usual at this time of the week," one banker said. The Egyptian trading week ends on Thursday.
